title: Inmunohistoquímica rápida
author: Antonio Hartley
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.r7sd9ne
materials: PBS x 2 minutos PBS x 2 minutos
Sumergir láminas en agua destilada x 5 minutos

steps.title: Xylene deparaffinization
steps.instruction: Immerse slides in xylene three times, 2 min each.

steps.title: Ethanol rehydration series
steps.instruction: Rehydrate slides through graded ethanol: 100 % ethanol 2 min twice, 95 % ethanol 2 min twice, 70 % ethanol 2 min, then rinse in running water until antigen retrieval is complete.

steps.title: Heat‑induced antigen retrieval
steps.instruction: Place slides in citrate buffer pH 6 and incubate in a steamer for 40 min.

steps.title: Endogenous peroxidase block
steps.instruction: Incubate slides in 10 % hydrogen peroxide diluted in methanol for 15 min.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Dilute primary antibody in PBS containing Twinn 20 and incubate slides for 40 min at 37 °C in a humid chamber.

steps.title: PBS‑Twinn wash
steps.instruction: Wash slides three times with PBS + Twinn 20, 2 min each wash.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Choose one: (A) incubate with secondary antibody diluted in PBS + Twinn 20 for 40 min at 37 °C in a humid chamber; or (B) incubate with polymer‑conjugated secondary antibody for 20 min at 37 °C in a humid chamber.

steps.title: Post‑secondary wash
steps.instruction: Wash slides three times with PBS + Twinn 20, 2 min each.

steps.title: Optional extra incubation
steps.instruction: If option A was used, incubate slides an additional 15 min at 37 °C.

steps.title: Second PBS‑Twinn wash
steps.instruction: Wash slides three times with PBS + Twinn 20, 2 min each.

steps.title: Chromogen development
steps.instruction: Incubate slides with DAB or appropriate substrate, placing the slide on a white background and monitor development under the microscope.

steps.title: Hematoxylin counterstain
steps.instruction: If the target is nuclear, stain with hematoxylin for 5 sec; if cytoplasmic or membrane, stain for 20 sec; then rinse in PBS.

steps.title: Dehydrate and mount
steps.instruction: Dehydrate slides through ascending alcohols, then mount with a hydrophobic mounting medium.
